title: The Shell That Sounded Like Not the Sea
youtube_title: The Shell That Sounded Like Not the Sea | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet noticing is a way of being gentle with the world.
summary: At a library aisle with a slice of sun, Pema finds a shell that sounded like your own ear and still felt magic. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Pema shows Niko how to look without disturbing it. Nana Ruth looks too, and they leave it where it is.
